[[Acolyte of Melandru]] is a [[Kournan military]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Marga Coast]].

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Marga Coast}}

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Aura of Thorns}}
*{{skill icon|Avatar of Melandru}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Fleeting Stability}}
*{{skill icon|Pious Concentration}}
*{{skill icon|Vital Boon}}
*{{skill icon|Wearying Strike}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Kournan Pendant]]
*[[Melandru's Grip]] ([[unique]])
*[[Tanned Hide Square]]

== Notes ==
* Conditions and elemental damage are ineffective against this boss when it uses Avatar of Melandru. 
** Keep her interrupted - she is much easier to kill if her form is not active.
** Kill the guards and healers before attempting to take on the boss.
** In [[hard mode]], applying [[Hex]]es will make things much easier.
* Party wide protection skills like [[Aegis]] work well.
* Consider bringing two [[Signet of Capture|Signets of Capture]] since [[Bubahl Icehands]] is just south of this boss.
